title: Military Color Guard Marching on Campus, 1966 B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A square-format snapshot depicting a four-man military or ROTC color guard marching along a wide outdoor campus pathway. The two inner members bear the American flag and an organizational standard, flanked by rifle bearers in matching service dress uniforms, peaked service caps, and white gloves. Bystanders and additional marchers are visible in the background against a backdrop of trees and an institutional brick building. The photo was processed in March 1966, an era marked by the growing prominence and scrutiny of collegiate military training amid the Vietnam War.
